name: Academic book
description: An academic book: half-title and title page, copyright, dedication and epigraph, the contents, foreword, preface and acknowledgements, the chapters, then appendices, glossary, notes, bibliography and a note on the author.

source.name: The front and back matter of a scholarly monograph, as the Chicago Manual of Style and the publishers surveyed have them
source.notes: Publishers ask for structure, not appearance (docs/research/formats-publishers.md); the order here is the customary one, and a part the book has not is simply not printed. The publishers' own templates are based on this one.
